chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm narrated from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Bashīr, from Abū al-Jārūd, from Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), who said:

Indeed, when that which came to Amīr al-Muʾminīn (صلوات الله عليه) came to him, he said to his son al-Ḥasan: “Come near me so that I may confide to you what the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) confided to me, and entrust you with that which he entrusted to me.” So he did.

key_terms.أَئْتَمِنَكَ: to entrust you with a trust
key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام)
key_terms.أُسِرَّ: to secretly convey or confide privately
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ: al-Ḥasan, the son of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام)
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم)

ai.seo_question: How did Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) entrust al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) before his death?
ai.summary: This narration describes Amīr al-Muʾminīn (صلوات الله عليه) at the time of his final moments, privately transmitting a trust and secret knowledge to his son al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام). It highlights the continuity of entrusted authority from the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) to Amīr al-Muʾminīn and then to al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام).

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Samad Bin Bashir, from Abu Al Jaroud, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, when there presented to him<sup>asws</sup> that which presented (death), said to his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>: ‘Approach me<sup>asws</sup> until I<sup>asws</sup> divulge a secret to you<sup>asws</sup> what Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> had divulged to me<sup>asws</sup>, and entrust you<sup>asws</sup> upon what he<sup>saww</sup> entrusted me<sup>saww</sup> upon’. So he<sup>asws</sup> did’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from’’Abd al-Samad ibn Bashir from abu al-Jarud from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“When Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) was about to leave this world, he called his son, al-Hassan (a.s.) saying, “ Come very close to me so I can speak to you secretly just as the Messenger of Allah did to me and entrust you with all that he entrusted me with and he did so.”
